public Mono<ReplyVo> getReply(String commentName, String replyName) {
        return getVisibleComment(commentName)
                .flatMap(comment -> populateReplyListOptions(comment)
                        .doOnNext(options -> options.setFieldSelector(
                                options.getFieldSelector().andQuery(equal("metadata.name", replyName))))
                        .flatMap(options -> client.listBy(Reply.class, options, PageRequestImpl.ofSize(1)))
                        .flatMapIterable(ListResult::getItems)
                        .next()
                        .flatMap(this::toReplyVo)
                        .flatMap(vo -> permalinkService
                                .getSubjectUrl(comment.getSpec().getSubjectRef())
                                .doOnNext(url -> vo.setPermalink(
                                        CommentPermalinkService.getPermalink(url, commentName, replyName)))
                                .thenReturn(vo)));
    }

content.text:
Refactoring 12 is done. Fixed 13 `doOnNext` misuses across four files in the theme/infra layer:

- **`PostPublicQueryServiceImpl`** (6 sites): VO population chain for listed post (stats, owner, tags, categories, contributors) and `convertToVo` content setter
- **`SinglePageConversionServiceImpl`** (4 sites): content/owner setters in `convertToVo`, and the reusable `populateStats`/`populateContributors` helpers
- **`CommentPublicQueryServiceImpl`** (5 sites): permalink setter, `ListOptions` field-selector mutation before `flatMap`, stats/owner setters in both `toCommentVo` and `toReplyVo`
- **`GlobalInfoServiceImpl`** (1 site): settings-to-`GlobalInfo` population inside `handleSettings`

The `doOnNext` sweep is now complete across the entire backend. The remaining open refactorings are the `PostReconciler`/`SinglePageReconciler` shared-method duplication and the `.block()` consolidation in reconcilers.
